title: Barrel Cannon
description: Fly with Barrel Cannon like Monkey!
body:
# Barrel Cannon

This mod add Barrel Cannon Inspired Donkey Kong Country.

Barrel Cannon is craftable Transport Item That can Place On Block

You can enter the Barrel Cannon When touched

once touched Those Barrel. You Can launched it self into the sky with jump key

## More Detail About Barrel Cannon

You can rotate Barrel Cannon That Looked Direction(shift key make Opposite Upside down)

and You Can Increase Barrel's launched power with Wind Charge
